```{r}
#| include: true
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "report.R"))
Standard.target <- c("GISTM", "CDA", "ANCOLD")
```

# Criterios de diseño de depósitos de relaves {#sec-criteria}

## Resumen ejecutivo {#sec-tsf_summary}

{{< include /_chapters/tailings.summary.es.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_summary/criteria_summary.es.qmd",
    stem = "criteria-summary",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    heading = SiteTable$label[[i]],
    level = 3L,
    anchor = "sec-criteria-summary-site",
    context = "resumen de criterios de relaves"
  )
}
rm(i)
```

### Etapa de operación {#sec-criteria_results_obe}

```{r}

#| results: asis

  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/DEQ_OBE.ES.qmd",
    stem = "criteria-obe-table",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    heading = SiteTable$label[[i]],

  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_fig/DEQ_OBE.ES.qmd",

    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "figura de criterios operacionales de relaves"
  )
}
rm(i)
```
